findings.detail: Source author's note uses ungendered 'I'm so happy'; current Russian 'я так рада' assigns female grammatical gender with no source basis. Rephrase without guessing author gender while preserving joy and gratitude.

source_anchor.quote: I'm so happy you are enjoying this story!

translation_anchor.quote: я так рада, что вам нравится эта история!

findings.detail: Literal rendering 'выражение остальной части лица безошибочно просияло от узнавания' is an awkward/unnatural Russian calque. Preserve that Marc recognizes Alex and his face lights up despite covered eyes, in idiomatic literary Russian.

source_anchor.quote: the way the rest of his expression lit up in recognition was unmistakable

translation_anchor.quote: выражение остальной части лица безошибочно просияло от узнавания

findings.detail: Alex says 'I was already done', with a singular subject, but translation says 'мы уже закончили', adding explicit plural 'we' in a scene where Alex conceals who he was speaking to. Preserve singular to avoid changing the implication for Marc.

source_anchor.quote: No worried, I was already done
